title: Comparison-Dependent Tape Action
statement: Let $r_1,r_2$ be work-tape indices, let $e_C,e_{By},e_{Bn}$ be states, and let $a,b$ be either Boolean symbols or blank. If $a=b$ and both are blank, the action moves the two indexed work-tape heads one cell left and enters $e_{By}$. If $a=b$ and they are not blank, it moves them one cell right and enters $e_C$; if $a\ne b$, it moves them one cell left and enters $e_{Bn}$. In every case it leaves the input head stationary, writes nothing, and emits no output symbol.
